name: flaggems_softmax
description: torch.nn.functional.softmax along a given dim. Extracted from FlagGems tests/test_softmax.py (test_softmax) with reference-only float64 upcast (to_reference(..., upcast=True)) and NaN/Inf-tolerant comparison (equal_nan=True). The neg_inf source variant replaces negative inputs with -inf, which can make softmax produce NaN, so a custom NaN/Inf-tolerant validator mirrors gems_assert_close(..., equal_nan=True).
